exposure: Provider training level (PGY 1 vs. PGY 2-4 or attending physician)
cohort: 116 patients who underwent postplacental levonorgestrel 52mg IUD placement from October 1, 2016, to March 31, 2017
finding: Postplacental levonorgestrel 52mg IUD expulsion rates are associated with provider training level as well as delivery route.
mod_finding: IUD expulsion occurred more frequently after vaginal than cesarean delivery (30.2% vs. 4.2%, OR 9.93 [95% CI 1.25-78.96]).
